title: Link Floer homology, nonformality, and the Borromean rings
summary: Our main result is a computation of the full link Floer complex of the Borromean rings. The Borromean rings are well known to be an L-space link. We prove that the full link Floer complex is not a free-resolution of its homology, in contrast to the situation for L-space knots, plumbed L-space links, and two-component L-space links. We also describe the link involution of the Borromean rings, up to a minor ambiguity.
